description: Statistics Jersey publishes the results of the 2021 Census on the Government of Jersey open data portal as one dataset with 77 CSV files, under the Open Government Licence for Jersey. The housing and transport files give the usual mode of travel to work for each parish, split into car, motorbike, walking, bus, cycling and working from home; in St Helier 9,610 people walked to work and 8,390 drove. Other files count households by accommodation type, from detached houses to purpose-built flats, by tenure and by parish, cars and vans and motorcycles per parish, persons and bedrooms by tenure and reasons for vacant dwellings, next to population by parish, vingtaine and electoral district. Coverage is national for the island of Jersey. Format and access: CSV downloads and a CKAN API, no registration; stats.je has themed census pages and an interactive map. Licence: Open Government Licence – Jersey v1.0. Caveats: counts appear rounded; parish names carry trailing spaces in some files; there are no questions on heating or utilities in the files listed. Simulation uses: commuting mode shares and car ownership by parish, and housing stock mix for small-island planning. Related records: none for Jersey in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Travel to work by parish: car, motorbike, walk, bus, cycle, work from home, other, all. Accommodation type by parish: detached, semi-detached, terraced, purpose-built flat, converted flat, flat in commercial building, tent, boat or portakabin. Other files: tenure by parish, households by property type and tenure, persons and bedrooms by tenure, vacant dwelling reasons, cars and vans by parish, motorcycles by parish, population by parish, vingtaine and electoral district, persons per dwelling 1971 to 2021, labour, health and education tables. Counts in the files read end in zero, so they appear rounded to tens.
